---
title: "Render course"
output: html_document
date: "2022-08-12"
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r }
library(rmarkdown)
root <- getwd()

for (dk in c("", "_dark")) {
  for (j in 1:4) {
    render(input = paste0(root, "/lecture", j, "/slides.Rmd"),
           params = list(dark = dk != ""),
           output_options = list(includes = list(after_body = paste0("insert-logo", dk, ".html"))), 
           output_file = paste0(root, "/lecture", j, "/slides", dk, ".html"))
  } 
  render(input = paste0(root, "/structure/home.Rmd"),
         params = list(dark = dk != ""), 
         output_file = paste0(root, "/home", dk, ".html"))
}

```
